non_compete_clause_apply.description: In France, non-compete clauses carry a large cost for employers and are not enforceable. Because of these reasons, we recommend selecting No.
non_compete_clause_apply.title: Non-competition and non-solicitation

helpCenter.callToAction: Learn more about non-competition and non-solicitation clauses in France
helpCenter.content:
What do I need to know?

While we make every effort to include non-competition and non-solicitation clauses in employment agreements, we cannot guarantee that they will be effective. These clauses are fact-specific and we will not be able to institute action to enforce them against an employee.

In France, you must commit to pay the employee a minimum of 35% of the employee’s monthly gross salary for the length of the non-compete whether or not the employee joins a competitor.

Because of this significant sum and because we cannot guarantee the effectiveness of a non-compete clause and we will not be able to institute action to enforce a non-compete against an employee, we recommend selecting No.
helpCenter.title: Non-competition and non-solicitation clauses in France

statement.description:
If you need Remote to terminate an employee (whether inside or outside of probation) in France because of your company’s economic or organizational circumstances, a mutual termination agreement must be entered into with the employee.

It is common for employees in France to bring claims and employers to pay settlements or to opt for termination by mutual agreement.

During probation, you do still have some more flexibility on termination; for example, when the termination reason is the employee’s performance. For this reason, we still recommend setting the probation period to the maximum allowed.
statement.title: Information on termination - probation

renewal_probation_length.description: Probation periods can be renewed once with a similar duration as the initial probation period (example: four months extended for an additional 4 months, for a total of eight months of probation period). Extension is not the default and we must follow a strict process for the extension to be effective. Should you want to extend the employee's probation period, please reach out to help@remote.com (opens in a new tab) to notify our team at least one month before the end date of the initial probation period. The probation period is automatically validated unless you or the employee notify Remote of your intent to extend.
renewal_probation_length.title: Renewal of Probation Period
